http://www.vangoghgallery.com/es/images/Van-Gogh_New-Template/prints-set1/print-starry-night.jpg

I just wanted to share probably one of my favorite and largest inspirations when it comes to my art.

Van Gogh is probably best known for his oil paintings, and it certainly is where most of his known work lies.

Unfortunately I wish I could be more thorough, but the little I know about Van Gogh doesn't change what I like about him, and about his work. When I look at it I see the stylization of otherwise normal things, and I'll be honest it is a kind of style I have started striving for lately, things that are somewhat stylized, but not completely abstract.

Also one of my favorite personal works was a design study of the one of Vincent Van Gogh's best known works, [Starry Night in ink and stylus](http://i.imgur.com/LV0Pcqz.jpg)

There just something about his works that captures something surreal, without making something that is necessarily abstract in form. I wish to be able to make something like that. It is one of the many artistic visions I wish to pursue.
